item.text: I’ll first check the existing workspace so I can build the registration app in the right place and fit any existing project structure.

The workspace is empty, so I’m creating a standalone HTML/CSS/JavaScript app. It will use a shared responsive navigation, searchable and filterable course catalog, registration flow with a confirmation dialog, and a student profile with a registered-course table.

Created a responsive course registration app with four navigable pages: Home, Course Catalog, Registration, and Student Profile.

The app includes searchable and filterable course cards, course selection, a registered-course table, credit totals, and a confirmation dialog. It also includes responsive layouts, keyboard-accessible navigation, a skip link, screen-reader labels, and reduced-motion support.

Files: [index.html](/work/index.html), [styles.css](/work/styles.css), [app.js](/work/app.js).
